newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells 2.06 pct up on foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: John Keells 2.06 pct up on foreign buying.

text.p: Shares of John Keells Holdings rose 2.06 percent or four rupees to 198 on foreign buying in late morning trade on Monday, brokers said.
"You have to pay a premium to get a big parcel of the share, which investors think is at bargain levels," said a broker who declined to be identified.
The share rose to over 400 rupees when the market last rallied in early 1994.
John Keells Holdings Ltd is Sri Lanka's largest blue chip conglomerate with more than 50 subsidiaries.
